annotations.title: Build Segment from Saved Integration Matches

description: Create a matched segment, or add unique saved identities to a compatible standalone matched segment. Call preview_saved_integration_segment first and confirm the exact counts and target with the user. Adding to an existing segment replaces its current version. Completion or failure may notify configured external webhooks and opted-in users by email. Reuses previously resolved identities and returns a segment for subsequent audience composition. Requires 'creator' scope.

filters.description: Select saved matches by provider, connection, run, source kind, or time window

mode.description: Create a new matched segment or add identities to an existing one

request_id.description: Stable idempotency key; generated when omitted

segment_name.description: Name for a new matched segment

target_segment_id.description: Existing matched segment ID when mode is add_to_segment

name: build_saved_integration_segment

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions
